replays.title: AI account refused every Bedrock model (29/10/2026), replayed on today's routes
replays.what_happened: On 29/10/2026 Bedrock refused model access for the LLM account at account level (Error 002): first the OpenAI models, then every model. No alert fired; the cause was found hours later after model-by-model checks. This replay puts the same refusal on today's primary Bedrock account (acc1) with today's routes: Claude = Anthropic API, then acc1, then acc3; GPT = acc1, then acc3, then the OpenAI API. acc3 keeps its known refusals of the GPT models.
